cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是英国广播公司国际台的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton, and at 14:00 GMT on Monday, the 17th of August, these are our top stories.
cues.zh: 我是西莉亚·哈顿，格林尼治标准时间8月17日星期一14点，以下是本期要闻。

cues.en: President Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner has held talks with the Israeli Prime Minister as he seeks to advance a US-backed peace plan for Gaza.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统的女婿贾里德·库什纳已与以色列总理举行会谈，以推动一项由美国支持的加沙和平计划。

cues.en: And Hayden Panettiere, best known for her roles in the TV shows Heroes and Nashville, has died at the age of 36.
cues.zh: 因出演电视剧《英雄》和《音乐之乡》而广为人知的海顿·潘妮蒂尔去世，终年36岁。

cues.en: Also in this podcast...
cues.zh: 本期节目还将报道……

cues.en: Was that a prank, or was that much more seriously, possibly a national security service trying to compromise him?
cues.zh: 那是一场恶作剧，还是严重得多的情况——可能是某个国家安全机构试图让他陷入不利境地？

cues.en: Could his phone have been compromised? Many questions that we don't know the answer.
cues.zh: 他的手机是否可能已被入侵？有很多问题，我们还不知道答案。

cues.en: Britain's Prime Minister exchanges messages with an impostor.
cues.zh: 英国首相与一名冒名顶替者互通信息。

cues.en: We start in the Middle East and the Trump administration's attempts to revive the floundering peace plan for Gaza.
cues.zh: 我们先来关注中东，以及特朗普政府试图挽救陷入困境的加沙和平计划。

cues.en: The US Middle East envoy Jared Kushner has taken on that task.
cues.zh: 美国中东特使贾里德·库什纳已接手这项任务。

cues.en: He arrived in Israel and has been meeting the Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for talks.
cues.zh: 他抵达以色列，并一直在与以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡举行会谈。

cues.en: Last month, Donald Trump announced that his Board of Peace had reached an historic deal for Gaza,
cues.zh: 上个月，唐纳德·特朗普宣布，他的“和平委员会”已就加沙达成一项历史性协议，

cues.en: but progress ground to a halt after Israel bluntly rejected the proposal.
cues.zh: 但以色列明确拒绝该提案后，进展陷入停滞。

cues.en: On Sunday, Jared Kushner gave an indication of how far the US is willing to go to put the deal back on track,
cues.zh: 周日，贾里德·库什纳的行动显示出美国为使协议重回正轨愿意走多远，

cues.en: when he travelled to Egypt for an unusual meeting with Hamas officials.
cues.zh: 他前往埃及，与哈马斯官员举行了一场不同寻常的会晤。

cues.en: Mr Kushner is reported to have pushed Hamas for a disarmament that would be verifiable.
cues.zh: 据报道，库什纳敦促哈马斯以可核查的方式解除武装。

cues.en: That's a key demand of Israel, which has refused to withdraw from Gaza until the group gives up its weapons.
cues.zh: 这是以色列的一项关键要求；在哈马斯放弃武器之前，以色列拒绝从加沙撤军。

cues.en: Earlier, I asked our correspondent Yolande Knell in Jerusalem if there are any signs of progress towards a deal.
cues.zh: 早些时候，我询问了本台驻耶路撒冷记者约兰德·内尔，是否出现了任何推动协议取得进展的迹象。

cues.en: A spokesman for the Israeli Prime Minister only confirmed to the BBC that this meeting between Jared Kushner and the Israeli Prime Minister was underway earlier.
cues.zh: 以色列总理的一名发言人只向BBC证实，贾里德·库什纳与以色列总理的这次会谈早些时候正在进行。

cues.en: But this happens after he met Hamas officials in this rare meeting in Egypt, along with other senior representatives of the Board of Peace:
cues.zh: 不过在此之前，他已在埃及罕见地会晤哈马斯官员，其他“和平委员会”高级代表也参加了会谈：

cues.en: Nikolai Mladenov, who's the High Commissioner for Gaza, and also the former British Prime Minister Tony Blair.
cues.zh: 其中包括加沙高级专员尼古拉·姆拉德诺夫，以及英国前首相托尼·布莱尔。

cues.en: They were in Egypt, along with regional mediators, meeting this Hamas delegation reportedly for about two hours to discuss Hamas commitments.
cues.zh: 他们与地区调解方一道在埃及同哈马斯代表团进行了据报约两小时的会谈，讨论哈马斯应履行的承诺。

cues.en: Now, Hamas has been saying that it will not implement this roadmap that it's agreed with the Board of Peace,
cues.zh: 哈马斯一直表示，它不会落实与“和平委员会”达成的这份路线图，

cues.en: that would see it completely disarming, unless Israel signs up to the deal.
cues.zh: 这份路线图将要求哈马斯彻底解除武装，但前提是以色列也加入协议。

cues.en: It involves a phased withdrawal of Israeli troops from Gaza,
cues.zh: 该路线图包括以色列军队分阶段撤出加沙，

cues.en: and of course the Israeli Prime Minister totally rejected that roadmap, speaking in meetings with his cabinet.
cues.zh: 而以色列总理在与内阁开会时彻底否决了这份路线图。

cues.en: And that's quite unusual for Israel to completely defy its closest ally, the US, and President Trump.
cues.zh: 以色列如此彻底地违抗其最亲密盟友美国及特朗普总统，实属不同寻常。

cues.en: So we've heard some opposition from Israel so far, but there is growing pressure from the United States for Israel to accept some sort of deal.
cues.zh: 因此，到目前为止我们听到了以色列方面的一些反对声音，但美国要求以色列接受某种协议的压力正不断增大。

cues.en: What can Jared Kushner do to nudge Benjamin Netanyahu towards agreeing to this proposal?
cues.zh: 贾里德·库什纳能采取什么行动，促使本雅明·内塔尼亚胡同意这项提案？

cues.en: They'll be giving reassurances from Hamas about its commitments to disarmament and about the verification process that has been agreed as part of this roadmap.
cues.zh: 他们将转达哈马斯就其解除武装承诺以及路线图中已商定的核查程序所作的保证。

cues.en: I think they will also be looking to Israel to meet Hamas's demands.
cues.zh: 我认为，他们也会要求以色列满足哈马斯的诉求。

cues.en: In terms of making sure that they stick to their commitments for the first stage of the already agreed ceasefire.
cues.zh: 确保以方履行已经商定的停火协议第一阶段所作的承诺。

cues.en: When it comes to humanitarian matters, when it comes to stopping military attacks on Gaza,
cues.zh: 这些承诺涉及人道主义事项，也涉及停止对加沙的军事袭击，

cues.en: because although there was a brief lull in those about a week ago, they have resumed in recent days,
cues.zh: 因为尽管大约一周前这些袭击曾短暂停歇，但最近几天又已恢复，

cues.en: with Israel saying that it is targeting what it calls terrorists from Hamas and Islamic Jihad.
cues.zh: 以色列称，其打击目标是它所谓的哈马斯和伊斯兰圣战组织恐怖分子。

cues.en: Yolande, what more can you tell me about the domestic political calculations that Benjamin Netanyahu is making?
cues.zh: 约兰德，关于本雅明·内塔尼亚胡正在进行的国内政治考量，你还能告诉我们些什么？

cues.en: We know he's moving towards a general election for Israel in late October.
cues.zh: 我们知道，以色列将在10月下旬举行大选。

cues.en: That's right. And in that general election, polls indicate that the Prime Minister's Likud party is currently struggling in the polls.
cues.zh: 没错。在那场大选中，民调显示，总理所属的利库德集团目前在民意支持方面处境艰难。

cues.en: There's a lot of pressure coming from members of the coalition, the governing coalition, especially those on the far right, to take a much harsher approach when it comes to Gaza.
cues.zh: 执政联盟成员正施加很大压力，尤其是其中的极右翼人士，要求在加沙问题上采取严厉得多的做法。

cues.en: So it's been much commented on how the National Security Minister, Itamar Ben-Gvir, has just recently given a podcast interview
cues.zh: 因此，以色列国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔最近接受播客采访一事，引发了广泛评论。

cues.en: in which he's calling for targeted assassinations to resume in Gaza on a nightly basis, killing 30 to 40 people,
cues.zh: 他在采访中主张每晚在加沙恢复定点暗杀，杀死30至40人，

cues.en: and he's specifying they don't need to be those who pose an immediate threat to Israel.
cues.zh: 而且他明确表示，被杀者不必是那些对以色列构成立即威胁的人。

cues.en: So that gives you a taste of some of the political discourse right now.
cues.zh: 由此可以一窥当下的部分政治言论氛围。

cues.en: Yolande Knell in Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 约兰德·内尔在耶路撒冷报道。

cues.en: Around the world, people in the film and television industry are paying tribute to the American actress Hayden Panettiere, who's died at the age of 36.
cues.zh: 世界各地的影视界人士都在悼念美国女演员海顿·潘妮蒂尔，她去世时年仅36岁。

cues.en: It's not yet clear how she died.
cues.zh: 目前尚不清楚她的死因。

cues.en: Ms Panettiere's career spanned three decades.
cues.zh: 潘妮蒂尔女士的演艺事业跨越了30年。

cues.en: She began when she was a young child and went on to score roles in hit television shows and films,
cues.zh: 她从童年时期便开始演艺生涯，后来出演了多部热门影视作品，

cues.en: including the Scream horror franchise and the TV series Heroes and also Nashville.
cues.zh: 包括恐怖片《惊声尖叫》系列，以及电视剧《英雄》和《音乐之乡》。

cues.en: She spoke to BBC Breakfast in 2013 about Nashville and the difficulties she faced in the spotlight.
cues.zh: 2013年，她在接受BBC《早餐新闻》采访时谈到了《音乐之乡》，以及身处聚光灯下所面对的困难。

cues.en: There's a lot of judgment, which is interesting because people ask me all the time where I pull this character from and whether it's a country music artist.
cues.zh: 人们有很多评判，这很有意思，因为总有人问我这个角色的灵感来自哪里，是不是来自某位乡村音乐歌手。

cues.en: Actually, just because I didn't grow up in the country music industry, you know, we're all in the same lunchroom, we're just eating at different lunch tables.
cues.zh: 其实，虽然我并不是在乡村音乐界长大的，但你知道，我们都在同一个午餐室，只不过坐在不同的餐桌旁吃饭。

cues.en: I still grew up, a young person, in the spotlight, dealing with a lot of scrutiny.
cues.zh: 我依然是在聚光灯下长大的年轻人，面对着许多审视。

cues.en: Our culture reporter Yasmin Rufo told me more.
cues.zh: 本台文化记者亚斯明·鲁福向我介绍了更多情况。

cues.en: She really did have such a varied career, but also a career that spanned almost her entire lifetime.
cues.zh: 她的演艺经历确实非常丰富，而且几乎贯穿了她的一生。

cues.en: Back in May, she told CBS News that she was just eight months old when her mum was taking her to auditions.
cues.zh: 今年5月，她告诉CBS新闻，母亲开始带她参加试镜时，她才8个月大。

cues.en: By the time she was five, she'd appeared in 50-odd commercials.
cues.zh: 到5岁时，她已经出演了50多则广告。

cues.en: Like you mentioned there, she was four when she appeared in the US soap One Life to Live.
cues.zh: 正如你刚才提到的，她4岁时就出演了美国肥皂剧《只此一生》。

cues.en: She then went on in her teenage years to star in A Bug's Life and Remember the Titans with Denzel Washington,
cues.zh: 十几岁时，她又出演了《虫虫危机》，并与丹泽尔·华盛顿共同出演《光辉岁月》，

cues.en: before becoming that household name as cheerleader Claire Bennet in that hit sci-fi series Heroes.
cues.zh: 之后，她凭借热门科幻剧《英雄》中啦啦队长克莱尔·贝内特一角家喻户晓。

cues.en: Then in Nashville, like you heard in that clip there, it was a totally different side of her, playing an up-and-coming country singer, Juliette Barnes.
cues.zh: 接着，在刚才片段中提到的《音乐之乡》里，她展现了完全不同的一面，饰演冉冉升起的乡村歌手朱丽叶特·巴恩斯。

cues.en: She actually performed the songs on the show as well, which would end up in charts at the time, and she earned two Golden Globe nominations.
cues.zh: 她还亲自演唱了剧中的歌曲，这些歌曲当时登上了排行榜，她本人也获得两次金球奖提名。

cues.en: And then, you know, she was in countless other films, the Scream franchises, Bring It On: All or Nothing, and, you know, various other TV and film throughout her career.
cues.zh: 然后，你知道，她还出演了无数其他电影，包括《惊声尖叫》系列、《美少女啦啦队：战斗到最后一刻》，以及贯穿演艺生涯的其他各种影视作品。

cues.en: I mean, she did so much in her career.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，她在演艺生涯中做了太多事情。

cues.en: It's hard to believe that she's now died at just the age of—young age of 36.
cues.zh: 很难相信她如今已经去世，年仅——只有36岁。

cues.en: Can you tell me more? She talked about struggles going on in her life.
cues.zh: 你能再多讲讲吗？她曾谈到生活中经历的挣扎。

cues.en: I think one of the important things is that her legacy isn't just being this incredible actress,
cues.zh: 我认为很重要的一点是，她留下的遗产不只在于她是一位出色的演员，

cues.en: but also being someone that was very open about some really extremely difficult periods in her life.
cues.zh: 也在于她非常坦率地讲述了人生中一些极其艰难的时期。

cues.en: She published her memoir in May.
cues.zh: 她在5月出版了回忆录。

cues.en: This Is Me: A Reckoning, it's called.
cues.zh: 书名叫作《这就是我：清算》。

cues.en: And in that she really details things like growing up in the industry and how difficult that was for her,
cues.zh: 她在书中详细讲述了自己在演艺行业长大等经历，以及这对她而言有多么艰难，

cues.en: addiction that she battled, substance abuse, and her later recovery.
cues.zh: 以及她与成瘾的抗争、物质滥用和后来康复的过程。

cues.en: And she also spoke a lot about the postpartum depression she experienced after giving birth to her daughter in 2014,
cues.zh: 她还多次谈到2014年生下女儿后所经历的产后抑郁，

cues.en: and then later her decision to give her daughter's father, Ukrainian boxer Wladimir Klitschko, full custody of the child.
cues.zh: 以及后来决定将孩子的完全监护权交给女儿的父亲、乌克兰拳击手弗拉基米尔·克利奇科。

cues.en: And I think one of the reasons that she's been so vocal on this is that she said she's always wanted other people to know that they weren't alone in that situation.
cues.zh: 我认为，她之所以如此公开地谈论这些，其中一个原因是她曾说，自己一直希望让其他人知道，他们在这种处境中并不孤单。

cues.en: So she opened up about postpartum depression as a way to help other people talk about it.
cues.zh: 因此，她公开讲述产后抑郁，是为了帮助其他人也能谈论这个问题。

cues.en: Similarly, she's spoken about things like the domestic abuse she's experienced in her life as a way to help inspire other people.
cues.zh: 同样，她也曾讲述自己生活中遭受家庭暴力等经历，希望借此鼓舞其他人。

cues.en: So I think it's really important to see her legacy not just as one of a successful actress who was in all of these brilliant TV and film shows,
cues.zh: 所以我认为，认识她留下的遗产时，不能只把她看作一位出演过众多优秀影视作品的成功演员，

cues.en: but as someone that really wanted to talk honestly and willingly about some of the experiences and the challenges that come with growing up in the spotlight.
cues.zh: 还应看到她真心希望坦诚、自愿地讲述自己的部分经历，以及在聚光灯下成长所带来的挑战。

cues.en: Our culture reporter Yasmin Rufo on the legacy left by the actress Hayden Panettiere.
cues.zh: 以上是本台文化记者亚斯明·鲁福对女演员海顿·潘妮蒂尔所留遗产的报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast...
cues.zh: 本期播客稍后还将报道……

cues.en: It didn't have that combustion engine roar of a sports car.
cues.zh: 它没有跑车内燃机那种轰鸣声。

cues.en: It had five seats, for goodness' sake.
cues.zh: 它居然有5个座位。

cues.en: It was just any other car.
cues.zh: 它就像任何一辆普通汽车。

cues.en: It's a Ferrari, but not like you've previously known it.
cues.zh: 它是一辆法拉利，却不是你过去所熟悉的那种法拉利。

cues.en: The rapper Tupac Shakur was gunned down on the Las Vegas Strip nearly 30 years ago,
cues.zh: 说唱歌手图派克·夏库尔近30年前在拉斯维加斯大道遭枪杀，

cues.en: becoming an unsolved killing that has haunted the world of hip hop for three decades.
cues.zh: 这起悬而未决的命案困扰嘻哈界长达30年。

cues.en: Now, Duane "Keffe D" Davis, a self-described former gang leader, is standing trial for his murder.
cues.zh: 如今，自称前帮派头目的杜安·“Keffe D”·戴维斯正因涉嫌谋杀他而受审。

cues.en: The BBC's Shaimaa Khalil is following the case.
cues.zh: BBC记者沙伊玛·哈利勒正在追踪此案。

cues.en: In 1996, Tupac Shakur was everywhere.
cues.zh: 1996年，图派克·夏库尔无处不在。

cues.en: "California Love" was an anthem, "All Eyez on Me" was selling millions, and he was starring in films.
cues.zh: 《California Love》成了时代颂歌，《All Eyez on Me》销量数以百万计，他还出演电影。

cues.en: At 25, Tupac was at the height of his career. At 25, he was gunned down.
cues.zh: 25岁时，图派克正处于事业巅峰；也正是在25岁时，他遭到枪杀。

cues.en: Because everybody still wanted to know what happened. There's been no movement in 30 years, um, which is wild to me.
cues.zh: 因为大家仍然想知道究竟发生了什么。30年来毫无进展，嗯，这让我觉得难以置信。

cues.en: I sat with Tupac's older brother, Mopreme Shakur, who described receiving the news that his brother had been shot in Las Vegas.
cues.zh: 我采访了图派克的哥哥莫普里姆·夏库尔，他讲述了得知弟弟在拉斯维加斯中枪时的情形。

cues.en: I know it's a long time ago, but what do you remember thinking?
cues.zh: 我知道那已经是很久以前的事了，但你还记得当时在想什么吗？

cues.en: Worried. I was just worried how bad it was.
cues.zh: 担心。我只是担心情况到底有多严重。

cues.en: All I had known was he got shot.
cues.zh: 我当时只知道他中枪了。

cues.en: So until I reached Vegas, I didn't know the status of things. And, um, 'Pac was a tough little dude.
cues.zh: 所以在我抵达拉斯维加斯前，我并不知道具体情况。嗯，'Pac 是个很坚强的小伙子。

cues.en: He had already been—survived being shot five times, and, um, I was just praying that it wasn't as worse as it was.
cues.zh: 他此前已经——在身中五枪后活了下来，嗯，我只祈祷这一次不要像实际情况那么严重。

cues.en: He had already survived one near-fatal shooting, but he couldn't survive a second.
cues.zh: 他已经从一次近乎致命的枪击中幸存，却没能挺过第二次。

cues.en: Rap star Tupac Shakur died last night after a brief life in a rough business. He was 25.
cues.zh: 说唱明星图派克·夏库尔昨晚去世，他在这个残酷行业中的短暂一生就此结束，年仅25岁。

cues.en: Tupac's murder has long been associated with the bitter East Coast-West Coast rap feud, but prosecutors say the shooting grew out of a confrontation involving rival Compton gangs.
cues.zh: 图派克谋杀案长期以来一直与东西海岸说唱界的激烈争斗联系在一起，但检方称，这起枪击源于康普顿敌对帮派之间的一场冲突。

cues.en: Nearly 30 years on, Duane "Keffe D" Davis is on trial for murder.
cues.zh: 近30年后，杜安·“Keffe D”·戴维斯因谋杀指控受审。

cues.en: You have the right to have the jury sentence you if they come back on a first-degree murder verdict,
cues.zh: 如果陪审团作出一级谋杀罪裁决，你有权要求由陪审团对你量刑，

cues.en: and you have decided to waive that right. Is that correct?
cues.zh: 而你已经决定放弃这项权利，对吗？

cues.en: And at the heart of the case are his own words, accounts he gave in interviews and in his memoir about his alleged role in the killing.
cues.zh: 案件的核心是他自己的言论，即他在采访和回忆录中对自己据称在杀人案中所扮演角色的讲述。

cues.en: Legal analyst and attorney Sean Kent says it will be an uphill battle for the defense.
cues.zh: 法律分析人士兼律师肖恩·肯特表示，辩方将面临一场艰难的战斗。

cues.en: This is what makes the case so fascinating.
cues.zh: 这正是此案如此引人关注的原因。

cues.en: The two biggest pieces of evidence against Keffe D came from Keffe D.
cues.zh: 针对 Keffe D 的两项最重要证据，都来自 Keffe D 自己。

cues.en: However, this doesn't mean that they're going to be presented to the jury as admissions of guilt.
cues.zh: 不过，这并不意味着这些内容会作为认罪陈述呈交陪审团。

cues.en: Keffe D has the right to take the stand and say, "I made all this up.
cues.zh: Keffe D 有权出庭作证并说：“这一切都是我编造的。

cues.en: I lied to sell copies of the book. I lied to the police. I'm a liar, but I did not murder Tupac."
cues.zh: 我撒谎是为了卖书，我对警察撒了谎。我是个骗子，但我没有谋杀图派克。”

cues.en: If he does decide to take the stand and give this kind of testimony, then he'll be cross-examined using his own words.
cues.zh: 如果他确实决定出庭并作出这样的证词，那么他将因自己过去的言论而受到交叉询问。

cues.en: It's Iron Mike Tyson!
cues.zh: 这是“铁人”迈克·泰森！

cues.en: On the night of September the 7th, 1996, Tupac and Death Row Records boss Suge Knight watched Mike Tyson fight at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas.
cues.zh: 1996年9月7日晚，图派克与死囚唱片公司老板苏格·奈特在拉斯维加斯米高梅大酒店观看了迈克·泰森的拳赛。

cues.en: Afterwards, security cameras captured Tupac and members of his entourage attacking Keffe D's nephew.
cues.zh: 之后，监控摄像头拍到图派克及其随行人员袭击 Keffe D 的侄子。

cues.en: Later that night, Tupac left with Suge Knight in a black BMW.
cues.zh: 当晚晚些时候，图派克与苏格·奈特乘一辆黑色宝马离开。

cues.en: At a junction near the Las Vegas Strip, a white Cadillac pulled alongside them.
cues.zh: 在拉斯维加斯大道附近的一个路口，一辆白色凯迪拉克开到他们旁边。

cues.en: Tupac was shot four times. He died six days later.
cues.zh: 图派克身中四枪，六天后去世。

cues.en: Tupac was just a fascinating character. I mean, every aspect of him. He was talented, he was complex, he was complicated.
cues.zh: 图派克是个极具魅力的人物。我是说，他的方方面面都是如此。他有才华、很复杂，也很难简单概括。

cues.en: Santi Elijah Holley is the author of "An Amerikan Family: The Shakurs and the Nation They Created".
cues.zh: 桑蒂·伊莱贾·霍利是《一个美国家庭：夏库尔家族及其缔造的国度》一书的作者。

cues.en: He provides good, just, just dance tracks, just make you feel just like you want to just, you know, cruise with your windows down.
cues.zh: 他能带来很棒的、就是、就是那种舞曲，让你感觉只想，怎么说呢，摇下车窗兜风。

cues.en: But he also makes you want to stop and think about, you know, social justice issues and sit down and actually parse his lyrics.
cues.zh: 但他也会让你停下来思考社会正义问题，坐下来真正细读他的歌词。

cues.en: Hey, Keffe, Metro Police. Come over here.
cues.zh: 嘿，Keffe，都会警察。到这边来。

cues.en: For decades, the murder investigation barely moved. No arrest, no trial.
cues.zh: 几十年来，谋杀案调查几乎毫无进展：无人被捕，也没有审判。

cues.en: Then, in 2023, Keffe D was arrested.
cues.zh: 随后在2023年，Keffe D 被捕。

cues.en: He's now charged with first-degree murder, accused of helping organize the attack, although prosecutors don't claim he fired the gun.
cues.zh: 他目前被控一级谋杀，并被指协助策划袭击，不过检方并未声称是他开枪。

cues.en: He's pleaded not guilty.
cues.zh: 他已作无罪答辩。

cues.en: Mopreme Shakur says he's cautiously optimistic about the trial, but after nearly 30 years, he says no verdict can give him what he truly wants.
cues.zh: 莫普里姆·夏库尔说，他对审判持谨慎乐观态度，但近30年过去，任何裁决都无法给他真正想要的东西。

cues.en: The justice I would like, I will never get.
cues.zh: 我想要的正义，我永远也得不到。

cues.en: I want my brother back. Period. Dot. I want my, I want my little brother back.
cues.zh: 我想要我的弟弟回来。句号。就是这样。我想要我的、我想要我的小弟弟回来。

cues.en: The amount of, of pain, distress, heartbreak, um, that the family has gone through and 'Pac's fans have gone through, um, it's unmatched.
cues.zh: 这个家庭以及 'Pac 的歌迷所经历的痛苦、煎熬和心碎，嗯，是无与伦比的。

cues.en: The trial may finally provide some answers about what happened that night,
cues.zh: 这场审判或许终于能为当晚发生的事情提供一些答案，

cues.en: but no verdict can fill the years of silence or fully explain why, after all this time, all eyes are still on Tupac Shakur. Shaimaa Khalil.
cues.zh: 但任何裁决都无法填补多年的沉默，也无法完全解释为何时至今日，所有目光仍聚焦于图派克·夏库尔。沙伊玛·哈利勒报道。

cues.en: Now to a potential hoax involving the British Prime Minister, Andy Burnham.
cues.zh: 下面来看一起可能涉及英国首相安迪·伯纳姆的骗局。

cues.en: He's reported to have exchanged messages with someone posing as a senior member of the US government, the White House Chief of Staff, Susie Wiles.
cues.zh: 据报道，他曾与一名冒充美国政府高级官员、白宫办公厅主任苏茜·怀尔斯的人交换信息。

cues.en: But that person was not who they were pretending to be.
cues.zh: 但那个人并非其所冒充的身份。

cues.en: Our political correspondent, Damian Grammaticas, is following this for us.
cues.zh: 本台政治记者达米安·格拉马蒂卡斯正在跟进此事。

cues.en: Well, Celia, this is intriguing and raises some of those exact questions.
cues.zh: 西莉亚，这件事很耐人寻味，也恰恰引出了其中一些问题。

cues.en: Now, what we do know is that Andy Burnham engaged in some sort of message exchange,
cues.zh: 目前我们确知的是，安迪·伯纳姆进行过某种信息交流，

cues.en: and it appears that he was responding to something and, as you say, thought that that was Donald Trump's Chief of Staff.
cues.zh: 看起来他是在回复某条信息，而且正如你所说，他以为对方是唐纳德·特朗普的办公厅主任。

cues.en: Officially, the government here will not comment because they say that this is a national security matter.
cues.zh: 英国政府正式拒绝置评，称这是国家安全事项。

cues.en: But what we understand from conversations is that we're told that nothing of significance was exchanged.
cues.zh: 但据我们从交谈中了解到的消息，有人告诉我们，双方没有交换任何重要内容。

cues.en: There was no verbal communication, and this was then reported to security authorities as soon as suspicions were raised.
cues.zh: 双方没有进行语音通话，而且一产生怀疑，此事就被报告给了安全部门。

cues.en: But really important questions: why did Andy Burnham engage with someone, it seems, he didn't know?
cues.zh: 但仍有非常重要的问题：安迪·伯纳姆为什么会与一名看起来并不认识的人联络？

cues.en: Why then did he, sort of, exchange messages with them?
cues.zh: 那么，他为什么又会同对方交换信息？

cues.en: Was that a prank, or was that, much more seriously, possibly a national security service trying to compromise him?
cues.zh: 这究竟是一场恶作剧，还是更严重的情况——可能有某个国家安全机构试图攻破他的防线？

cues.en: Could his phone have been compromised? Many questions that we don't know the answer to.
cues.zh: 他的手机有没有可能遭到入侵？还有许多问题，我们都不知道答案。

cues.en: And I'm sure some embarrassment on the Burnham side as well.
cues.zh: 我相信伯纳姆一方多少也会感到尴尬。

cues.en: But this isn't the first time, is it, that a UK high-level politician has been tricked into messaging with someone who isn't who they thought they were?
cues.zh: 不过，英国高级政治人物被诱骗、与身份并非本人所想的人通信，这已经不是第一次了，对吗？

cues.en: No, absolutely, and that is also, I think, instructive here because two years ago, the then Foreign Secretary, David Cameron, who had been Prime Minister,
cues.zh: 确实不是。我认为这也很有启示意义，因为两年前，时任外交大臣、曾任首相的戴维·卡梅伦

cues.en: messaged and then took part in a video call with someone who he thought was a former Ukrainian president, Petro Poroshenko.
cues.zh: 曾与一名他以为是乌克兰前总统彼得罗·波罗申科的人互发信息，随后还参加了视频通话。

cues.en: Now, he became suspicious after that.
cues.zh: 此后，他起了疑心。

cues.en: Two years before that, the then Defence Secretary, Ben Wallace, also had a video chat with someone he thought was the Ukrainian Prime Minister.
cues.zh: 再往前两年，时任国防大臣本·华莱士也曾与一名他以为是乌克兰总理的人进行视频通话。

cues.en: They even discussed a possible UK deployment of warships or nuclear weapons issues with Ukraine. That was blamed on Russia.
cues.zh: 他们甚至讨论了英国可能部署军舰或与乌克兰相关的核武器议题。此事被归咎于俄罗斯。

cues.en: A video was released online, an edited video.
cues.zh: 后来网上出现了一段经过剪辑的视频。

cues.en: The interesting thing here, I think, is that all those were calls that were put through from switchboards and government departments.
cues.zh: 我认为值得注意的是，之前那些通话都是由总机和政府部门转接的。

cues.en: This was something that Andy Burnham seems to have engaged in. Again, why there are questions.
cues.zh: 而这一次看起来是安迪·伯纳姆主动参与了联络。因此，这里才会再次出现疑问。

cues.en: Interesting. And Andy Burnham is keen to come across as someone who's very approachable.
cues.zh: 很有意思。安迪·伯纳姆一直希望给人留下非常平易近人的印象。

cues.en: But moving forward, do you think his team is going to have to change how they do things, perhaps,
cues.zh: 但今后你认为他的团队是否必须改变做法，

cues.en: and maybe do a little bit more vetting before he engages and messages with someone?
cues.zh: 比如在他与别人接触、通信前进行更多核查？

cues.en: Well, that certainly has been his, sort of, public profile, if you like, as being someone who's keen to talk, keen to engage, keen to listen and hear from people.
cues.zh: 这确实一直是他的某种公众形象：一个愿意交谈、愿意接触，也愿意倾听民众声音的人。

cues.en: I think the issue that this raises exactly is: why did he do that in this case?
cues.zh: 我认为此事引出的核心问题正是：他为什么在这次事件中这样做？

cues.en: But it appears to have happened since he entered Downing Street, perhaps in the early days.
cues.zh: 不过，这件事看起来发生在他入主唐宁街后，或许是在上任初期。

cues.en: And it appears that, I'm sure, his team will have learned lessons from this.
cues.zh: 看起来，我相信他的团队会从这件事中吸取教训。

cues.en: Usually, in this instance, I think you'd expect a government-to-government communication to come through an embassy, through diplomatic sources, through the Foreign Office.
cues.zh: 通常在这种情况下，政府间通信应当通过大使馆、外交渠道或外交部进行。

cues.en: Of course, leaders nowadays do communicate back and forth on WhatsApp, but certainly I think they will be much more cautious here about who he does engage with.
cues.zh: 当然，如今各国领导人确实会通过WhatsApp来回沟通，但我认为今后他们一定会更加谨慎地核查他的联络对象。

cues.en: Damian Grammaticas.
cues.zh: 达米安·格拉马蒂卡斯报道。

cues.en: To Zambia now. Let's get the latest on the aftermath of the presidential election last Thursday.
cues.zh: 下面来看赞比亚。来看上周四总统选举后的最新情况。

cues.en: With more than half the votes counted, officials say the current president, Hakainde Hichilema, is pulling ahead.
cues.zh: 在超过一半选票完成统计后，官员表示现任总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马正在取得领先。

cues.en: But while the counting is going on, there's political turmoil unfolding elsewhere.
cues.zh: 但在计票进行的同时，其他地方也正在发生政治动荡。

cues.en: The government says the security forces have arrested 11 people involved in an alleged insurrection plot.
cues.zh: 政府称，安全部队已逮捕11名涉嫌参与叛乱阴谋的人。

cues.en: They say the main opposition candidate was found at the scene of the raid, where they seized weapons.
cues.zh: 政府还称，主要反对派候选人出现在突袭现场，安全部队并在那里缴获了武器。

cues.en: Dingindaba Jonah Buyoya is in Zambia for us.
cues.zh: 丁金达巴·乔纳·布约亚正在赞比亚为我们报道。

cues.en: The raid happened in the capital.
cues.zh: 这次突袭发生在首都。

cues.en: Even if the details of this are quite scanty at the moment, the government issued a statement yesterday simply saying
cues.zh: 尽管目前相关细节相当有限，但政府昨天发布声明称，

cues.en: that they found a group of people who were in possession of what they described as high-grade military equipment, military weapons.
cues.zh: 他们发现一群人持有政府所称的高等级军事装备和军用武器。

cues.en: And as a result of that, there was some sort of exchange of fire.
cues.zh: 随后发生了某种形式的交火。

cues.en: There are no details on whether or not anyone was injured from there.
cues.zh: 目前没有关于是否有人在交火中受伤的细节。

cues.en: But the opposition NRPU leader, Brian Mundubile, says that some of his team members were shot and their whereabouts are unknown.
cues.zh: 但反对党NRPU领导人布赖恩·蒙杜比莱称，他的一些团队成员遭到枪击，目前下落不明。

cues.en: In fact, they've gone to the extent of suggesting that some of these people actually died.
cues.zh: 事实上，反对派甚至声称，其中一些人可能已经死亡。

cues.en: The government had initially denied that there was any such thing. Yesterday, it did come out to issue a statement saying that a raid did in fact happen on Friday.
cues.zh: 政府最初否认发生过此类事件，但昨天发布声明，承认周五确实发生了一次突袭。

cues.en: Now, this is just the latest chapter in what's been quite a dramatic election, with some criticising how it's been carried out.
cues.zh: 这只是这场波折不断的选举中的最新一幕；一些人批评选举的实施方式。

cues.en: Can you take us through the campaign and through some of the challenges that we've seen with the vote?
cues.zh: 你能否介绍一下竞选过程，以及我们在投票中看到的一些问题？

cues.en: The observers who have spoken out now have said that the campaign period was fairly peaceful, even election day itself.
cues.zh: 已经发声的观察员表示，竞选期间总体较为平静，投票日本身也是如此。

cues.en: However, there were concerns around how the election was conducted with regard to fairness.
cues.zh: 不过，人们对选举实施过程是否公平存在担忧。

cues.en: The Electoral Commission of Zambia had put out a schedule within which presidential candidates would campaign in various parts of the country,
cues.zh: 赞比亚选举委员会曾发布一份日程，规定总统候选人在全国不同地区开展竞选活动的时间，

cues.en: but that schedule was not applicable to the president and vice president, who would go anywhere at whatever time.
cues.zh: 但这份日程并不适用于总统和副总统，他们可以在任何时间前往任何地方。

cues.en: And, you know, some of these stakeholders felt that that wasn't fair.
cues.zh: 而一些利益相关方认为这并不公平。

cues.en: Voting day itself brought its own issues.
cues.zh: 投票日本身也出现了一些问题。

cues.en: While it was largely peaceful, you know, counting of votes on Friday was suspended, and it was suspended by the Electoral Commission of Zambia across the country
cues.zh: 虽然投票日总体平静，但周五的计票工作被暂停；赞比亚选举委员会在全国范围内暂停了计票，

cues.en: because they said there were some polling stations where ballot papers had been stolen, ballot boxes had been stolen.
cues.zh: 因为委员会称，一些投票站的选票和投票箱遭到盗窃。

cues.en: Now, there are no details of where these ballot boxes were stolen from and where this violence occurred.
cues.zh: 目前没有关于这些投票箱从何处被盗、暴力事件发生在哪里的具体信息。

cues.en: And some observers have said this lack of detail is creating the impression that, you know, the Electoral Commission may be hiding something.
cues.zh: 一些观察员表示，细节缺失给人造成一种印象，即选举委员会可能在隐瞒某些事情。

cues.en: And now the incumbent is pulling ahead in the vote count. Will that help settle things?
cues.zh: 目前现任总统正在计票中领先。这会有助于平息局势吗？

cues.en: At the moment, the situation in the country is pretty calm.
cues.zh: 目前，赞比亚国内局势相当平静。

cues.en: There is police presence in a lot of densely populated areas
cues.zh: 许多人口稠密地区都有警察驻守，

cues.en: because there was some sort of unrest on Friday, the 14th of August, when Brian Mundubile had claimed victory in the election.
cues.zh: 因为8月14日星期五曾发生某种骚乱；当时布赖恩·蒙杜比莱宣称自己赢得了选举。

cues.en: Some of his supporters had taken, you know, to the streets.
cues.zh: 他的一些支持者走上了街头。

cues.en: And so there's been a deployment of heavy police presence and military presence, actually, in a lot of the streets of densely populated areas.
cues.zh: 因此，许多人口稠密地区的街道上部署了大批警察，实际上也有军队驻守。

cues.en: With regard to whether the vote has credibility, there's already a dispute.
cues.zh: 至于这次投票是否可信，目前已经存在争议。

cues.en: The opposition NRPU are saying that what they're describing as industrial-scale rigging—that's what they're calling it.
cues.zh: 反对党NRPU称存在其所说的“工业规模舞弊”——这是他们使用的说法。

cues.en: They've not brought forth any evidence of it at the moment, but they are clearly disputing what is being announced by the Electoral Commission of Zambia.
cues.zh: 目前他们尚未拿出任何证据，但显然是在质疑赞比亚选举委员会公布的结果。

cues.en: And since we spoke to Dingindaba Jonah Buyoya in Zambia,
cues.zh: 在我们采访驻赞比亚的丁金达巴·乔纳·布约亚之后，

cues.en: the main opposition party has rejected government accusations that its members were involved in plotting an insurrection at the time of the election.
cues.zh: 主要反对党已否认政府关于其成员在选举期间参与策划叛乱的指控。

cues.en: Now, when you think of a Ferrari sports car, you might imagine this sound.
cues.zh: 说到法拉利跑车，你或许会想到这样的声音。

cues.en: The roar of an engine, usually accompanied by a tiny number of seats and a slick exterior.
cues.zh: 发动机的轰鸣，通常还伴随着极少的座位和流线型外观。

cues.en: But now, something new for the Italian car company: a very quiet electric car.
cues.zh: 但现在，这家意大利汽车公司推出了新产品：一款非常安静的电动汽车。

cues.en: And the first one off the production line is making headlines after being sold at a charity auction.
cues.zh: 首辆下线的新车在一场慈善拍卖中售出，因而登上了新闻头条。

cues.en: Maura Fogarty is our Asia business editor in Singapore, and she told me how much that car sold for.
cues.zh: 本台驻新加坡亚洲商业编辑莫拉·福加蒂告诉我，这辆车拍出了多少钱。

cues.en: The Luce, which means light in Italian, at an auction in California over the weekend, sold for 40 million US dollars.
cues.zh: Luce 在意大利语中意为“光”；这辆车周末在加利福尼亚的一场拍卖会上以4000万美元成交。

cues.en: Now, that's the highest price ever at an auction for a brand-new car.
cues.zh: 这是全新汽车在拍卖会上创下的历史最高成交价。

cues.en: We've had higher prices, of course, for kind of vintage cars.
cues.zh: 当然，一些古董车曾拍出更高的价格。

cues.en: But for a brand-new car just off the production line, this was the highest price ever.
cues.zh: 但对于刚刚下线的全新汽车来说，这是有史以来的最高价格。

cues.en: Now, this Luce was designated as a chassis zero, meaning it's the first of its kind of this new series of electric vehicles that Ferrari is unveiling.
cues.zh: 这辆 Luce 被指定为0号底盘，也就是说，它是法拉利正在推出的这一全新电动汽车系列中的首辆车。

cues.en: So it was quite surprising that it sold for this amount of money, and I'm sure Ferrari is feeling pretty good about it as well.
cues.zh: 所以它能卖出这个价格相当令人惊讶，我相信法拉利对此也颇为满意。

cues.en: All the proceeds from the sale, according to Sotheby's auction house, goes towards the Ferrari Foundation's educational programs.
cues.zh: 据苏富比拍卖行称，此次拍卖的全部所得将用于法拉利基金会的教育项目。

cues.en: So I guess this was a bit of welcome news as well for Ferrari, because the car company did receive a bit of backlash when it first announced it was going to be making these cars.
cues.zh: 我想这对法拉利来说也是一个好消息，因为这家车企首次宣布将生产这类汽车时，确实遭到了一些反对。

cues.en: Yeah, that's right. And in fact, we saw the share price of Ferrari drop after it unveiled the car,
cues.zh: 是的，没错。事实上，法拉利发布这款车后，我们看到其股价出现下跌，

cues.en: and a lot of the criticism was based over a few things.
cues.zh: 许多批评主要集中在几个方面。

cues.en: First was how it looked.
cues.zh: 首先是它的外观。

cues.en: Many people, or the critics of the car, the Luce, said that the car looks like any other vehicle.
cues.zh: 许多人，也就是 Luce 的批评者，说这辆车看起来和其他汽车没什么两样。

cues.en: It looks like a normal electric vehicle. It didn't look special. It didn't look Ferrari, for example.
cues.zh: 它看起来就像普通电动汽车，毫不特别，例如，看起来并不像一辆法拉利。

cues.en: It did have a very kind of star brand-name designer working with the Luce, and that's Sir Jony Ive, who worked at Apple previously.
cues.zh: 不过，Luce 确实有一位堪称明星级的大牌设计师参与设计，那就是曾任职于苹果公司的乔尼·艾维爵士。

cues.en: He then started his own design agency and worked with Ferrari on designing the interiors of the car.
cues.zh: 后来他创办了自己的设计机构，并与法拉利合作设计这款车的内饰。

cues.en: So the first criticism was around how it actually looked.
cues.zh: 所以第一类批评针对的是它的实际外观。

cues.en: The second one was the fact that Ferrari was making an electric vehicle in the first place,
cues.zh: 第二类批评针对的是法拉利一开始就决定生产电动汽车这件事，

cues.en: that, you know, it didn't have that combustion engine roar of a sports car.
cues.zh: 因为你知道，它没有跑车内燃机的那种轰鸣声。

cues.en: It didn't—it had five seats, for goodness' sake. That was another criticism.
cues.zh: 它并没有——它居然有5个座位。这也是一项批评。

cues.en: That it wasn't a real Ferrari car. It was just any other car.
cues.zh: 也就是说，它不是真正的法拉利，只是一辆普通汽车。

cues.en: So the criticisms were twofold: one around how it looked, and one around the fact that it was diluting the Ferrari brand.
cues.zh: 所以批评主要有两方面：一是它的外观，二是它稀释了法拉利品牌。

cues.en: It's interesting, though, to see that Ferrari and some other European automakers are starting to move into the world of electric vehicles with real gusto.
cues.zh: 不过，有意思的是，法拉利和其他一些欧洲汽车制造商正开始大举进军电动汽车领域。

cues.en: You know, because in China, in the region where you're sitting right now in Singapore,
cues.zh: 你知道，因为在你目前身处新加坡的这个地区，

cues.en: China is already dominating the world of electric vehicles by far.
cues.zh: 中国已经遥遥领先，主导着全球电动汽车市场。

cues.en: It certainly is, and it does show that Ferrari and other European carmakers are trying to, at least at the high end of the market, target a specific type of buyer, right?
cues.zh: 的确如此，这也说明法拉利和其他欧洲车企正试图至少在高端市场瞄准某一特定类型的买家，对吧？

cues.en: I should mention, too, that when Ferrari announced the Luce, it said it had—it didn't give exact numbers,
cues.zh: 我还应该提到，法拉利发布 Luce 时曾表示已经——它没有给出确切数字，

cues.en: but there was an expectation, according to reports, that it wanted to sell just under 500 of these cars by the end of this year.
cues.zh: 但据报道，外界预计法拉利希望在今年年底前售出略少于500辆这款汽车。

cues.en: Ferrari says it has met those sales targets already.
cues.zh: 法拉利表示，它已经完成了这些销售目标。

cues.en: Now, you mentioned the Chinese car market, or at least the Chinese EV suppliers.
cues.zh: 你刚才提到了中国汽车市场，或者更准确地说，中国电动汽车供应商。

cues.en: They definitely dominate the world when it comes to electric vehicles.
cues.zh: 在电动汽车领域，它们无疑占据着全球主导地位。

cues.en: We've actually seen the number of Chinese EVs exported around the world just in the first half of this year.
cues.zh: 仅在今年上半年，我们就看到了中国电动汽车出口到全球各地的数量变化。

cues.en: I've got some figures for you here.
cues.zh: 我这里有一些数据。

cues.en: They were up 120% in the first six months of this year compared to the year-ago period.
cues.zh: 今年前6个月，这一数字较去年同期增长了120%。

cues.en: Maura Fogarty in Singapore.
cues.zh: 莫拉·福加蒂在新加坡报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是本期节目的全部内容。

cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送电子邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由凯·佩里负责混音。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I'm Celia Hatton. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是西莉亚·哈顿。下次再见。
